shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*chart*' -g '*Chart*' -g '*theme*' -g '*Theme*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'README*' -g 'index.html' -g '*lock*'"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' /home/sandbox 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'useTheme|useThemeType|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme* node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(SegmentedRadioGroup|Select|Button|ThemeProvider).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -65 && cat index.html && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -100 && rg --files node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer' | head"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /tmp && npm ls --depth=0 && command -v chromium || command -v google-chrome || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --prefix /tmp/pulse-browser playwright --no-audit --no-fund && /tmp/pulse-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/pulse-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/styles.css index.html'

/bin/bash -lc 'id && cat /etc/os-release && command -v apt-get && command -v sudo && ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | head && ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell'
/bin/bash -lc 'ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell && ls /var/lib/apt/lists'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/pulse-browser/libs /tmp/pulse-browser/debs
cd /tmp/pulse-browser/debs
apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libxi6 libxtst6 libatspi2.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libfontconfig1 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libdatrie1 libpixman-1-0 libgraphite2-3 libfribidi0
for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/pulse-browser/libs; done'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx && git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '255,380p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '380,510p' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/pulse-browser/debs
apt-get download libxrender1 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0
for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/pulse-browser/libs; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx && npm run build && git status --short && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/pulse-browser/debs
apt-get download libwayland-server0
dpkg-deb -x libwayland-server0*.deb /tmp/pulse-browser/libs
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'DEBUG=pw:browser LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/pulse-browser/debs
apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core
for package in libsqlite3-0*.deb fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/pulse-browser/libs; done
FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -45 && cat .gitignore && git diff -- src/main.tsx index.html'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/await page.locator('h2').innerText()"'!=='"'Динамика заказовi'/"'!(await page.locator('"'h2').innerText()).includes('Динамика заказов')/\" /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs
FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/pulse-browser/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/pulse-browser/font-cache</cachedir><match target="pattern"><test qual="any" name="family"><string>sans-serif</string></test><edit name="family" mode="assign" binding="same"><string>DejaVu Sans</string></edit></match></fontconfig>
EOF
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/pulse-browser/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';let p='/tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs',s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(\"if("'!(await page.locator('"'h2').innerText()).includes('Динамика заказов'))throw Error('Metric not changed');\", \"await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('h2')?.textContent.includes('Динамика заказов'));console.log('metric',await page.locator('h2').textContent());\");fs.writeFileSync(p,s);
JS
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/pulse-browser/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/check.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'tail -110 src/styles.css'

/bin/bash -lc 'FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/pulse-browser/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pulse-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/pulse-browser/final-check.mjs
npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css
npm run build
git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true});\" 
git status --short"
